notes: CHILD-AFTER-DEATH RESOLVED (research 2026-07-04): 'Michael Murray' (I182625292192, b./bapt. 1843) is a MIS-ATTACHED record and is NOT a child of this John Murray. His only source is 'Ireland, Catholic Parish Registers, 1655-1915' (S506435674), with a baptism recorded at Galway, Ireland, 14 Dec 1843 -- a place and Catholic-register source with no connection to this Scots-descended, Prince Edward Island/Tabusintac (New Brunswick) family, who by 1843 had been on this side of the Atlantic for over 40 years (father's own parents emigrated from Canonbie, Dumfriesshire, Scotland to PEI by the 1790s). Independent, well-cited research (WikiTree Murray-2863, citing NBGS of Miramichi archival files, PARO-PEI baptismal/marriage records, and 1851/1861 NB censuses) documents exactly five children of John Murray and his wife -- James (c.1814), Ann Jane (c.1815, m. John Blake), Mary (1817, m. James Robertson of Birch Hill, PEI), Charlotte Sophia (c.1819, m. John Jenkins, PEI), and 'possibly John' (c.1821) -- matching five of this record's six listed children exactly, with Michael the only outlier. Recommend removing I182625292192 from this record's children array (or re-flagging it there as a rejected/misattached hint) and NOT propagating an S506435674-sourced Irish baptism into this Canadian family's story.

DEATH DATE: the vitals-block death year 1821 (documented, sourced to Geneanet Community Trees Index S508118847) is corroborated by independent research: WikiTree Murray-2863 (citing New Brunswick Genealogical Society files) states widow Honoria remarried Ephraim Gay in 1822, and the 1861 NB census lists her as 'Honora Gay,' widow -- consistent with John's death in 1821 or very early 1822. The separate unsourced `events` array entry giving death as 18 Jun 1822 should be treated as the less reliable of the two and is likely either a duplicate/rounding artifact or an unverified secondary guess; 1821 is the better-supported year. Recommend either deleting the 18 Jun 1822 events entry or downgrading it to explicitly 'contradicted-by-documented-1821' rather than leaving it silently inconsistent.

BIRTHPLACE (open, not corrected): the documented vitals-block birthplace 'Saint John, New Brunswick' (S508118847) conflicts with this record's OWN unsourced events-array entry (23 Aug 1791, 'PE Island, Canada') and with WikiTree Murray-2863, which gives 21 Aug 1791 at Bedeque, Prince County, Prince Edward Island, son of John Murray Sr. and Eliza/Liza Chambers who emigrated PEI-to-Tabusintac by 1799-1803. Two independent lines point to PEI, not Saint John, NB; flagging as an open question rather than overriding the 'documented' Geneanet source outright, since no primary PEI baptismal record was directly viewed.

WIFE'S SURNAME (open, cross-reference only, not edited here): this record's spouse I182195863332 is entered as 'Honoria Beatty.' No independent source for 'Beatty' was found. Every external record located (WikiTree Murray-2863 via NBGS files, PARO-PEI marriage/baptismal records, 1851/1861 NB censuses) names her Honoria Hierlihy, daughter of Philip Hierlihy and Charlotte (Howe) Taylor of the well-documented Tabusintac Hierlihy/Taylor settler family, who remarried Ephraim Gay in 1822 after John Murray's death. This strongly suggests 'Beatty' is a tree error for 'Hierlihy,' but the fix belongs on I182195863332's own record, not here.
